helper.title: Privileged helper
helper.hint: Install a small system service so TUN, Zapret, AmneziaWG and OpenVPN can run while the interface stays unprivileged. Installation and removal stop BYDLO connections and require administrator approval. Only bundled engines are accepted; custom configs, plugins, relay chains and external rule sets require the existing elevated mode. OpenVPN requires its driver to be installed separately on Windows.
helper.changed: Helper updated. New connections use the current installation.
helper.error: The helper request failed or administrator approval was cancelled. Check the bundled engines, supported profile options and service installation. Remove the helper to return to the existing elevated mode.
helper.outdated: The privileged helper is outdated. In Settings → Advanced, remove the helper and install it again from this BYDLO release.
helper.unsupported: The helper supports Windows, Linux with systemd, and macOS with launchd. Use the existing elevated mode on other platforms.

routing.sources.title: Rule set sources
routing.sources.hint: Downloads run only when you press Download pinned rule sets. Pin an HTTPS URL and SHA-256. Use a source tag for sing-box geosite/geoip rules; use geo codes for Xray. backup.title: Backup and transfer
backup.hint: One password-encrypted file with servers, subscriptions, credentials, settings and routing rules. Use at least 12 characters for export and keep the password safe. Import requires only the password field; confirmation is for export. Local engine paths, autostart and Mock Mode stay on this device. External configuration files and engine binaries are not included.
backup.password.invalid: Use at least 12 characters and enter the same password twice.
backup.merge.hint: Merge: matching IDs are overwritten; other servers and subscriptions stay. Settings come from the backup; routing lists are combined. Telegram proxy credentials come from the backup when present.
backup.replace.hint: Replace: servers, subscriptions, Telegram proxy credentials, settings and routing lists are replaced by the backup. Items marked for removal will be deleted.
backup.disconnect: Stop all BYDLO connections and tools before importing.
backup.export.exists: The selected file already exists. Choose a new file name so the previous backup is kept.
backup.imported: Backup imported. Connections start only when you choose to connect.
backup.error: Could not process the backup. Check the password, file format and available storage.
backup.secret.failed: Could not export backup: credentials for '{0}' are missing or unreadable. Unlock the credential store or restore the profile, then try again.
share.title: Share server
share.warning: The link, QR code or configuration contains credentials that grant access to this server. Share only with people you trust. Exported files are not encrypted. Configurations referencing external files require those files separately.
share.error: Could not share this server. Check that its credentials are available. If the QR code is too large, copy the link instead.
onboarding.title: Welcome to BYDLO
onboarding.text: Add a server link, subscription or configuration file. BYDLO can choose a compatible connection engine automatically.
onboarding.consent.title: Optional GitHub features
onboarding.consent.text: Each permission below is off until you tick it. BYDLO works with none of them: servers, connections and error messages stay available.
onboarding.consent.updates.hint: BYDLO reads the release feed on GitHub to find a new version and can download it. Nothing is checked or downloaded until you allow it.
onboarding.consent.notifications.hint: BYDLO loads notification content from GitHub: release notes and maintainer announcements. The system may ask for its own notification permission after you allow this; the checkbox records only your choice in BYDLO.
onboarding.consent.themes.hint: BYDLO downloads the theme gallery index and theme files from GitHub and parses them as JSON colors. Nothing is downloaded or parsed until you allow it.
settings.consent.title: GitHub access
settings.consent.hint: These three permissions are independent and off until you allow them. Revoking one stops only its own background requests; the other two keep working.
settings.consent.updates.hint: Checks the GitHub release feed and downloads packaged updates. Turning it off also cancels a downloaded update that has not been applied yet.
settings.consent.notifications.hint: Loads notification content from GitHub and shows desktop notifications. The system may ask for its own permission separately.
settings.consent.themes.hint: Downloads the theme gallery index and theme files from GitHub and parses them as JSON colors.
contributors.subtitle: People who build BYDLO. The list is loaded from GitHub together with the update check.
contributors.empty: The list has not been loaded yet. It is refreshed at most once per day when automatic update checks are on.

tools.subtitle: Standalone helpers that run next to (or without) your VPN.
tools.zapret.desc: Helps open blocked websites and Discord without a VPN server.
tools.zapret.lists.helper: Zapret runs through the privileged helper, which uses its own lists. Lists from this editor are not used, so editing and saving are disabled. To use your own lists, remove the helper in Settings → Advanced and run BYDLO with administrator privileges.

tools.zapret.tcpts: Flowseal recommends enabling TCP timestamps (netsh interface tcp set global timestamps=enabled). BYDLO does not change this system setting for you.
tools.tg.desc: Turn on the proxy, then use the button beside it to open Telegram and confirm the connection.
tools.tg.dcip.hint: One DC:IP per line. If photos or videos do not load, keep only 4:149.154.167.220 or clear the list (upstream advice).
tools.tg.cf: Cloudflare fallback when WebSocket is unavailable
tools.tg.cfdomains.hint: One domain per line. Empty: the list maintained by Flowseal, refreshed every hour.
tools.tg.runtime.builtin: Built-in engine: no Python or extra downloads needed.
tools.tg.notelegram: Telegram did not open. Copy the link and send it to yourself in Telegram.
tools.tg.secret.restart: New secret generated. Restart TgWsProxy and update Telegram.
tools.engines.hint: Releases include pinned sing-box, Xray, OpenVPN and AmneziaWG (Windows/Linux). Downloads are a fallback for missing sing-box/Xray. Native WireGuard still uses an installed client.
about.wintun: Userspace tunnel adapter for bundled AmneziaWG on Windows
about.geodata: Unmodified routing databases from the upstream Xray package

about.libcap: Static library for bundled OpenVPN on Linux
about.pkcs11: Library from the official OpenVPN Windows package
about.vcruntime: Runtime from the official OpenVPN Windows package

tools.openvpn.driver.hint: Install the bundled signed DCO driver and a BYDLO-OpenVPN adapter once. Administrator rights are required. They remain installed after BYDLO closes; no OpenVPN GUI or background service is installed.
tools.openvpn.driver.consent: I agree to install the driver and adapter on this computer
tools.openvpn.driver.mock: Driver setup is disabled in Mock Mode and during development checks.

error.engine.openvpn.driver.admin: Restart BYDLO as administrator in Settings, then install DCO.
error.engine.openvpn.driver.package: The bundled DCO package is missing or incomplete. Download a complete BYDLO release.
error.engine.openvpn.driver.reboot: DCO was staged. Restart Windows, then retry setup in BYDLO.
error.engine.openvpn.driver.refused: Windows refused the DCO driver. Check administrator rights and the package signature.
error.engine.openvpn.driver.adapter: DCO was staged, but the BYDLO adapter could not be created. Retry setup.

error.engine.wireguard.reserved: The WireGuard 'reserved' option must be three bytes, e.g. '1,2,3'.
error.engine.amnezia.legacy: The custom AmneziaWG path selects an old client. Clear that path or select the bundled bydlo-amneziawg host.
error.engine.amnezia.network: AmneziaWG network setup failed. Check administrator rights, system tools and the recovery journal; an existing bydlo-awg interface or reserved route can also block setup.
error.engine.amnezia.macos.network: AmneziaWG network setup failed on macOS. Check root privileges, ifconfig, route, networksetup and the recovery journal amnezia-macos-network.json. Retry disconnecting to restore saved DNS and peer routes.
routing.subtitle: Split tunneling, DNS and rules. Applied on the next connect.
routing.mesh.hint: Leaves 100.64.0.0/10 and fd7a:115c:a1e3::/48 outside the tunnel so other VPN / mesh-network clients keep working.
routing.private.hint: Home router, printers and LAN stay direct.
routing.only.hint: Everything else goes direct (split tunneling, include mode).
routing.dns.hint: Enter a DNS server IP address or hostname; select its transport under Advanced. System DNS (or "local") uses the OS resolver regardless of the VPN checkbox. These settings do not change system DNS.
routing.process.only: Send only listed apps through the VPN
routing.process.tun: App allowlisting requires sing-box in TUN mode.
routing.process.hint: Process names, e.g. game.exe. sing-box: TUN mode only. Xray: Windows/Linux only.
stats.subtitle: Live speed, totals and the event log.
stats.nostats: This engine does not report live traffic yet.

theme.custom.ioerror: Could not access the theme storage. Check permissions and disk space.

theme.custom.consent: Theme downloads are off. Allow downloading and parsing themes in Settings → GitHub access.
theme.custom.gallery.error: Could not load the theme gallery. Check the connection and retry.

settings.sysproxy.hint: Available on Windows, macOS, GNOME and KDE. Previous settings are restored on disconnect or after restarting the app following a crash.
settings.lan.hint: Other devices on your network can use the local proxy (SOCKS5 + HTTP). Off by default.
settings.lan.warning: Anyone on your LAN with the login and password can route traffic through this device.
settings.lan.saved: Password is saved on this device.
settings.lan.nopassword: No password saved yet — the option cannot be enabled without one.
settings.lan.firewall: BYDLO does not change firewall rules automatically; allow the port yourself if needed.
settings.lan.sysproxy: Cannot be combined with the system proxy (it carries no credentials): turn one of them off.
lan.auth.login.required: LAN access is on but the proxy login is empty. Set it in Settings → Advanced.
lan.auth.password.required: LAN access is on but the proxy password is missing. Set it in Settings → Advanced.
settings.mock.hint: Simulates connecting, traffic and errors. No engine is started and no traffic is carried. For UI testing only.
settings.mock.forced: Forced on by --mock / BYDLO_MOCK=1 for this session.
settings.admin.hint: TUN, WireGuard / AmneziaWG / OpenVPN and Zapret need administrator rights or the privileged helper. Import and Local proxy mode work without elevation. Restart stops BYDLO connections after administrator approval; connect again in the new window.
settings.admin.cancelled: Elevation did not start. Connections were kept.
settings.admin.failed: Could not finish stopping connections. BYDLO remains open; the elevated window will not start while this window is running. Retry disconnecting before restarting.
settings.admin.manual: In-app restart with elevated rights is only available on Windows. On Linux/macOS, restart BYDLO with root rights (for example, via sudo) to use TUN, tunnels and Zapret.
settings.admin.autorestart: Run with administrator rights at startup
settings.admin.autorestart.hint: Windows only. When enabled, BYDLO asks for elevation (UAC) on startup. If you decline, it keeps working with limited features.
settings.safelock: Development safety lock is active (BYDLO_SAFE_DEV=1): real engines will refuse to start.
about.text: Free and open-source launcher for VPNs, proxies and open-internet tools. BYDLO is a front-end: the real work is done by the projects below. Huge thanks to their authors.
about.licenses: BYDLO: GPL-3.0-or-later. Original third-party licenses and notices are included beside the application: LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, licenses/ and engines/licenses/.
about.singbox: Proxy engine; its license also includes name-use terms. Original text and source are included in the release.
about.skia: Graphics and text rendering; native component notices are included in licenses/.
about.angle: Graphics backend on Windows, via Avalonia
about.dbus: D-Bus support on Linux, via Avalonia
about.dotnet: Runtime and platform libraries; original third-party notices are included in licenses/.
orphans.text: Engines from a previous session are still running.
crash.text: The app closed unexpectedly. A redacted crash report was saved.
report.hint: Copies a redacted diagnostic report: version, OS, engine versions, settings without secrets, recent logs and the latest crash report. Paste it into a bug issue.
store.recovered: Settings or profiles were recovered from a backup copy.
store.reset: Settings or profiles were damaged and have been reset. The broken file was kept for inspection.
store.newer: Data was created by a newer BYDLO version. Update the app instead of overwriting it.
tools.zapret.native: Administrator / root required. User lists are saved in BYDLO data and survive application updates. Native presets are separate from Flowseal strategies; effectiveness depends on your network.
tools.zapret.macos: macOS: IPv4 TCP 80/443 only. No UDP/QUIC, IPv6 or game filter. Root traffic is excluded. Requires root, a free port 21771 and the standard com.apple/* PF anchors. User lists survive updates.
tools.zapret.stopupdate: Stop Zapret before updating its managed files.
about.zapret.native: winws / nfqws / tpws: handling DPI filtering; MIT license included in the release.
about.cygwin: Windows runtime for winws. Linking Exception, license and corresponding source included in the release.
about.newlib: Cygwin C library; additional license notices included in the release.
settings.killswitch: Block Internet if the VPN disconnects (TUN / sing-box)
settings.killswitch.warning: Warning: Internet stays blocked during VPN failure and reconnection until you disconnect. LAN and mesh exceptions follow Routing settings; other direct/split rules are ignored. Requires a running TUN guard; a guard crash or forced termination can release protection. To restore access, use Disable kill switch and disconnect, or close BYDLO. After an app crash, restart BYDLO with the same privileges to release the old TUN.
settings.killswitch.ack: I understand the warning and how to restore access
settings.killswitch.active: Enabled for the next TUN connection. Local proxy mode is unaffected.
settings.killswitch.next: Kill switch will apply on the next TUN connection.
settings.killswitch.recovery: Could not stop the old TUN. Restart BYDLO with the same administrator/root rights and try again.
error.killswitch.dns: Kill switch requires remote DNS through the proxy. Select an IP address and UDP, TCP, HTTPS, TLS or QUIC; direct DNS, system DNS and DNS hostnames are unavailable in this mode.
error.killswitch.active: A kill switch TUN is already active. Disconnect first.
error.killswitch.tun: The kill switch TUN stopped. Protection may be unavailable. Disconnect before connecting again.
error.killswitch.engine: Kill switch requires sing-box in TUN mode. Disable it in Settings to use this engine.

settings.update.ready: Update downloaded; it will be installed on exit.
about.velopack: Application installers and updates; MIT license.
settings.update.auto.hint: Packaged builds download the update once a day at startup and install it on exit after connections stop. Settings, profiles and subscriptions are preserved. Off by default; disabled in Mock Mode.
settings.update.engines: Engine updates available: {0}. Install only releases with verified SHA-256.
settings.update.error: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
settings.update.locked: Update checks are disabled in Mock Mode and safe development.
settings.update.auto.unavailable: Unavailable for this copy: it was started from an archive or in Mock Mode. Install the Setup.exe build to update automatically.
settings.update.deferred: The update is downloaded but postponed. It installs on the next exit after every connection stops.
settings.update.manual.deb: BYDLO was installed from a .deb package, so your package manager owns it. Download the new .deb from the release page and install it with sudo apt install ./bydlo_<version>_amd64.deb. No apt repository is configured, so apt upgrade alone will not find new versions.
settings.update.manual.arch: BYDLO was installed from an Arch package, so pacman owns it. Update it with your AUR helper (for example yay -S bydlo-bin) or rebuild the package. The built-in updater never changes files owned by pacman.
settings.update.manual.nix: BYDLO was installed from the Nix flake, so Nix owns it. Update it with nix profile upgrade or by rebuilding your NixOS configuration.
settings.update.manual.portable: This copy runs from a portable folder or an old ZIP release. To update, quit BYDLO completely, replace the whole folder with the new release and keep your data directory. Automatic migration to an installed build is not provided.
settings.update.manual.unknown: This copy was not installed by a supported package, so automatic updates are unavailable. Install a release package to receive updates.
settings.update.detail.unavailable: This copy runs from an archive and cannot update itself. Install the Setup.exe build to receive updates.
settings.update.detail.consent: Automatic updates are off. Allow them under GitHub access.
update.trust.catalog: The update catalog could not be verified, so nothing was installed. The current version is kept.
update.trust.expired: The update catalog has expired or the system clock is wrong, so nothing was installed. Check the date and time and try again.
update.trust.unsupported: This update is not offered for your platform or channel, so nothing was installed. The current version is kept.
update.trust.downgrade: The offered update is not newer than the installed version, so nothing was installed.
update.trust.mismatch: The downloaded update does not match the signed catalog, so nothing was installed. The current version is kept.

tools.select.details: Takes several minutes and temporarily enables Zapret. Administrator/root rights are required. Tests each BAT configuration or native preset twice with the Test Zapret 1.10.3 standard HTTP/TLS suite. Results describe only these URLs and HTTP/TLS checks, not video playback, Discord voice, UDP or the whole BAT script. The original running configuration is restored before you apply a result.
